notes.zh: 修复更新下载后安装程序未出现及旧版本目录无法覆盖的问题；加入启动确认、日志、取消保护与安装后自动重开。安装占用减少约30.4%；升级时按SHA256清理已停用的旧运行库，保留配置、报告及修改文件。含双语指南和详细邮箱诊断。
notes.en: Fixes installer handoff and legacy-folder upgrades, with startup acknowledgment, logs, safe cancellation and verified relaunch. Reduces installed payload by 30.4%; upgrades remove obsolete runtime files only when SHA256 matches, preserving configuration, reports and modified files. Includes bilingual guides and detailed mailbox diagnostics.

notes.zh: 全新四页侧栏：邮件报告、邮箱与检查、AI服务、通用设置。报告正文通高显示；切页保留未保存输入，首次配置后同步表单；新增脱敏邮箱连接诊断和双语使用指南。
notes.en: New four-page sidebar for reports, mailboxes, AI and general settings. Full-height Markdown reader, preserved form drafts and first-run form synchronization, detailed sanitized mailbox diagnostics and bilingual guides.
